content: For the top middle screw, if you use a small razor knife to create a tiny chamfer, it will make starting that screw much easier.  Also, if you thread a screw most of the way in before putting the part in then take the screw out, the screw will go in much easier when installing the bed stop into the printer.
Verify the alignment of the nuts by threading in the screw before you put the part onto the printer.  If you can't get them in with just your fingers, then they aren't aligned yet.
I used a needle nose pliers to help align it and then push it home.
it helps to use the smallest Allen wrench to push it in
I did not remove those earlier...
